title: Mallard Duck Movement
text:
This site explores GPS tracks from 52 mallards recorded between 2007 and 2017. Their fixes cluster around Lake Constance, in central Europe where Germany, Switzerland, and Austria meet, and extend north and east across Europe. The records are most numerous in autumn—especially September—while observed speeds tend to be higher in summer and early autumn.
The tracking data comes from the PPBDS misc.tutorials repository. Explore the locations on the Map, or compare monthly fix counts and speed distributions on the Seasons page.
